title.en: Breeders recommend combing a Maine Coon two or three times a week.
title.sl: Vzrejevalci svetujejo, da Maine Coon počešeš dva- do trikrat na teden.

why.en: That's why you comb your cat 3 times a week in the game.
why.sl: Zato v igri svojo muco počešeš 3-krat na teden.

facts.quote: breeders recommend combing your Maine Coon two or three times a week.

title.en: Regular grooming keeps a Maine Coon's coat in good condition and prevents knots.
title.sl: Redno česanje ohranja dlako Maine Coona lepo in preprečuje vozle.

why.en: If you miss combing, your cat gets a knot in its fur.
why.sl: Če česanje zamudiš, ima tvoja muca vozel v dlaki.

facts.quote: they will require regular grooming to keep the coat in good condition and prevent knots and mats.

title.en: Cats need two or three play sessions of 10 to 15 minutes a day.
title.sl: Muca potrebuje na dan dve ali tri igre, vsaka traja od 10 do 15 minut.

why.en: That's why you play with the feather wand twice a day.
why.sl: Zato se s palico s peresom igraš dvakrat na dan.

facts.quote: In general, you should play with your cat for two or three 10- to 15-minute play sessions a day

title.en: Kittens have lots of energy and need more frequent play than adult cats.
title.sl: Mucki imajo ogromno energije in se morajo igrati pogosteje kot odrasle mačke.

why.en: That's why a kitten needs 3 wand games a day.
why.sl: Zato mucek potrebuje 3 igre s palico na dan.

facts.quote: Compared to adult cats, kittens have boundless energy and require more frequent and intense play sessions.

title.en: Cats prefer a wand toy that moves away from them, the way prey would move.
title.sl: Muca ima najraje igračo na palici, ki se umika od nje, tako kot plen.

why.en: That's why you pull the feather away from your cat in the game.
why.sl: Zato v igri pero vlečeš stran od muce.

facts.quote: They much prefer the fishing rod toy moving away from the cat, similar to how prey would move.

title.en: Cats are far-sighted: they can't see well closer than 25 centimetres.
title.sl: Mačke so daljnovidne: bližje od 25 centimetrov ne vidijo dobro.

why.en: So don't wave the feather right in front of your cat's face.
why.sl: Zato pera ne mahaj muci tik pred obrazom.

facts.quote: Cats are far-sighted, meaning they can't see well under 25 centimetres.

title.en: An indoor cat needs pretend hunting, play and high places to climb.
title.sl: Muca, ki živi v stanovanju, potrebuje lov za igračo, igro in visoka mesta za plezanje.

why.en: Your game cat lives indoors, so your wand game is its hunt.
why.sl: Tvoja muca v igri živi v stanovanju, zato je igra s palico njen lov.

facts.quote: simulated hunting and foraging opportunities, play, safe territory with vertical space

title.en: A healthy adult cat poos once or twice a day and pees two to four times a day.
title.sl: Zdrava odrasla mačka kaka enkrat ali dvakrat na dan in lula dva- do štirikrat na dan.

why.en: That's why your cat uses the litter tray in the game every day.
why.sl: Zato tvoja muca v igri vsak dan uporabi pesek.

facts.quote: Healthy adult cats poo once or twice a day. … Healthy adult cats pee two to four times a day.

title.en: Poo and pee should be removed from the litter tray at least twice a day.
title.sl: Iz peska je treba vsaj dvakrat na dan odstraniti kakce in lulo.

why.en: That's why you scoop the litter soon after your cat uses it.
why.sl: Zato pesek počistiš kmalu po tem, ko ga muca uporabi.

facts.quote: You should remove any poo and pee from their litter tray at least twice a day.

title.en: The litter tray should be cleaned out completely at least once a week.
title.sl: Pesek je treba vsaj enkrat na teden v celoti zamenjati in pladenj očistiti.

why.en: That's why you change all the litter once a week.
why.sl: Zato ves pesek zamenjaš enkrat na teden.

facts.quote: You should clean out the litter tray completely at least once a week.

title.en: Until they are six months old, kittens usually do best with three meals a day.
title.sl: Do šestega meseca je za mucke običajno najbolje, da dobijo tri obroke na dan.

why.en: That's why your kitten has three meal times a day.
why.sl: Zato ima tvoj mucek tri obroke na dan.

facts.quote: Until they are six months old, kittens will usually do best when fed three meals a day.

title.en: Vets call a cat a kitten from birth until it is 1 year old.
title.sl: Veterinarji mački pravijo mucek od rojstva do 1. leta starosti.

why.en: In the game, your kitten becomes a young cat at 12 months.
why.sl: V igri tvoj mucek pri 12 mesecih postane mlada mačka.

facts.quote: kitten, from birth up to 1 year old

title.en: The Maine Coon matures slowly: it can take up to three years to reach full size.
title.sl: Maine Coon dozoreva počasi: do polne velikosti lahko potrebuje do tri leta.

why.en: That's why your young Maine Coon still looks like it is growing.
why.sl: Zato tvoja mlada muca Maine Coon še vedno raste.

facts.quote: This is a slow-maturing breed that can take up to three years to reach full growth.

title.en: A cat needs a sturdy, tall scratching post.
title.sl: Muca potrebuje trden in visok praskalnik.

why.en: That's where you take your cat when it scratches the couch.
why.sl: Tja odneseš muco, ko opraska kavč.

facts.quote: Provide your cat with a sturdy scratching post, at least three feet high.

title.en: Maine Coons are affectionate and always up for a cuddle.
title.sl: Muca Maine Coon je ljubeča in vedno pripravljena na crkljanje.

why.en: When the care is done, a cuddle in the app makes your cat happy.
why.sl: Ko je skrb opravljena, muco razveseli crkljanje v aplikaciji.

facts.quote: Maine Coon cats are affectionate and tactile pets – always up for a cuddle

title.en: The Maine Coon is the official cat of the US state of Maine, where the breed comes from.
title.sl: Maine Coon je uradna mačka ameriške zvezne države Maine, od koder pasma izvira.

facts.quote: it was named the official cat of the state of Maine, where it originated

title.en: The Maine Coon comes from working cats that lived on farms in north-east America.
title.sl: Maine Coon izvira iz delovnih mačk, ki so živele na kmetijah na severovzhodu Amerike.

facts.quote: traces its origin to the working cat … found on the farms of Northeast America.

title.en: The Cat Fanciers' Association calls the Maine Coon the largest of all pedigree cats.
title.sl: Ameriško združenje CFA Maine Coon imenuje največjo od vseh rodovniških mačk.

facts.quote: the largest of all pedigreed cats

title.en: In the breed standard, lynx-like tufts of hair on the ears are desirable.
title.sl: Po standardu pasme so risji čopki dlake na ušesih zaželeni.

facts.quote: Lynx-tufts are desirable. Tufts of hair in the ears extend beyond outer edges of ears.

title.en: A Maine Coon has large, round paws with tufts of fur between the toes.
title.sl: Muca Maine Coon ima velike, okrogle tace s šopki dlake med prsti.

facts.quote: Large, round and well tufted between the toes

title.en: A Maine Coon's tail is at least as long as its body.
title.sl: Rep muce Maine Coon je vsaj tako dolg kot njeno telo.

facts.quote: At least as long as the body from shoulder-blade to base of tail.

title.en: A Maine Coon's fur is short on the head and shoulders and gets longer down the back and sides.
title.sl: Dlaka Maine Coona je na glavi in ramenih kratka, po hrbtu in bokih pa vedno daljša.

facts.quote: Short on head, shoulders and legs, becoming gradually longer down the back and sides

title.en: A Maine Coon's heavy coat is built-in protection from the cold.
title.sl: Gost kožuh Maine Coona jo varuje pred mrazom.

facts.quote: These cats have heavy, flowing coats for built-in protection from the cold

title.en: A Maine Coon "talks" with chirps, trills and purrs, and only meows now and then.
title.sl: Maine Coon se »pogovarja« s čivkanjem, žvrgolenjem in predenjem, mijavka pa le včasih.

facts.quote: Their daily conversation may include chirps, trills, and purrs as well as an occasional meow

title.en: Many Maine Coons are fond of water and will watch a dripping tap with fascination.
title.sl: Veliko muc Maine Coon ima rado vodo in navdušeno opazuje kapljajočo pipo.

facts.quote: Fond of water, many will watch a dripping faucet in fascination

title.en: Maine Coons can be taught to fetch, walk on a lead and open doors.
title.sl: Maine Coon se lahko nauči prinašati, hoditi na povodcu in odpirati vrata.

facts.quote: they are said to be very intelligent and can be taught to fetch, walk on leads and open doors.

title.en: A Maine Coon stays playful all its life.
title.sl: Muca Maine Coon ostane igriva vse življenje.

facts.quote: Retaining their playful ways throughout their life, a Maine Coon is an affectionate and fun companion.

title.en: Pedigree kittens usually go to their new home when they are over 12–13 weeks old.
title.sl: Rodovniški mucki gredo v nov dom običajno, ko so stari več kot 12–13 tednov.

why.en: That is why a Maine Coon kitten arrives in PetPrep at 3 months.
why.sl: Zato mucek Maine Coon v PetPrep pride star 3 mesece.

facts.quote: Pedigree kittens are usually rehomed over 12-13 weeks old

title.en: Once a cat is adult, at about one year, feeding once or twice a day is appropriate in most cases.
title.sl: Ko je mačka odrasla, pri približno enem letu, sta v večini primerov primerna en ali dva obroka na dan.

why.en: PetPrep uses two meal times a day for adult cats.
why.sl: PetPrep pri odraslih mačkah uporablja dve okni za obrok na dan.

facts.quote: Once the cat becomes an adult, at about one year of age, feeding once or twice a day is appropriate in most cases.

title.en: ASPCA advises keeping cats indoors: outdoor cats do not live as long as indoor cats.
title.sl: ASPCA svetuje, da mačka živi v stanovanju: zunanje mačke ne živijo tako dolgo kot notranje.

why.en: The cat in PetPrep is an indoor cat.
why.sl: Muca v PetPrep je notranja mačka.

facts.quote: Please keep your cat indoors. Outdoor cats do not live as long as indoor cats.

title.en: PDSA advises daily coat care for a Maine Coon to reduce the chance of knots and tangles.
title.sl: PDSA svetuje vsakodnevno nego dlake Maine Coona, da je manj vozlov in zapletov.

why.en: Sources range from daily to weekly; PetPrep uses 3 times a week.
why.sl: Viri svetujejo od vsak dan do enkrat na teden; PetPrep uporablja 3-krat na teden.

facts.quote: The Maine Coon coat needs daily attention to reduce the chance of knots and tangles.

title.en: Maine Coons can shed quite heavily in spring, when old, dead coat needs extra care to remove.
title.sl: Maine Coon se spomladi lahko precej močno lini, takrat je treba odmrlo dlako skrbneje odstranjevati.

facts.quote: They can shed quite heavily in the Spring, when extra care will have to be taken to ensure any old, dead coat is removed.

title.en: According to the CFA, Maine Coons get along well with children and other animals.
title.sl: Po navedbah CFA se Maine Coon dobro razume z otroki in drugimi živalmi.

facts.quote: They get along well with children and other animals

title.en: Fairly independent, Maine Coons need a moderate amount of human interaction.
title.sl: Muca Maine Coon je precej samostojna in potrebuje zmerno mero druženja z ljudmi.

facts.quote: Fairly independent, Maine Coon Cats need a moderate amount of human interaction

title.en: Maine Coons are high-energy and, because of their size, need plenty of room to play.
title.sl: Muca Maine Coon ima veliko energije in zaradi svoje velikosti potrebuje dovolj prostora za igro.

facts.quote: They are high energy, and because of their large size need plenty of room to play

title.en: PDSA gives an average weight of 7 kg for a Maine Coon.
title.sl: PDSA navaja povprečno težo Maine Coona 7 kg.

facts.quote: Average weight | 7kg

title.en: In the breeding statistics of FIFe, the international cat federation, the Maine Coon is number 1.
title.sl: V statistiki vzreje mednarodne mačje zveze FIFe je Maine Coon na 1. mestu.

title.en: In 1959, the CFA declared the Maine Coon extinct.
title.sl: Leta 1959 je ameriško združenje CFA Maine Coon razglasilo za izumrlo pasmo.

why.en: The breed survived: today it is one of the most popular.
why.sl: Pasma je preživela in je danes med najbolj priljubljenimi.

facts.quote: in 1959 the Maine Coon was declared extinct by CFA.

title.en: PDSA gives the Maine Coon an average lifespan of 12–15 years.
title.sl: PDSA navaja povprečno življenjsko dobo Maine Coona 12–15 let.

facts.quote: Average lifespan | 12-15 years

title.en: There is a DNA test for HCM, a heart condition, in Maine Coons.
title.sl: Za HCM, bolezen srca, obstaja pri Maine Coonu test DNK.

why.en: Ask the breeder about the parents' test results.
why.sl: Vzreditelja vprašajte za rezultate testov staršev.

facts.quote: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) … There is a DNA test for HCM in Maine Coon cats

title.en: In the UK, the GCCF requires DNA tests for MC HCM, SMA and PKdef for its breeding register.
title.sl: V Združenem kraljestvu GCCF za vpis v register za vzrejo zahteva teste DNK za MC HCM, SMA in PKdef.

facts.quote: DNA testing for MC HCM, SMA, PKdef will be require for registration on the Active Register from 1.1.24.

title.en: Hip dysplasia has no simple gene test, but breeding cats can be X-rayed to check their hips.
title.sl: Za displazijo kolkov ni preprostega genskega testa, lahko pa se plemenskim mačkam kolke slika z rentgenom.

facts.quote: there is no simple gene test for this condition. … breeding cats can be X-rayed to assess the conformation of the hip joints

title.en: PDSA recommends discussing the medical history of a kitten's parents and grandparents.
title.sl: PDSA priporoča, da se pozanimate o zdravstveni zgodovini staršev in starih staršev mucka.

facts.quote: We’d recommend discussing the medical history of your potential kitten’s parents and grandparents
